Helper class for high DPI.

'private void ChangePalette(PaletteMode palMode) { PALETTENAME.SuspendUpdates(); PALETTENAME.BasePaletteMode = palMode; PaletteImageScaler.ScalePalette(this, PALETTENAME); PALETTENAME.ResumeUpdates(); }'

Use the above mentioned method on the 'Click' event of the control.
